title: My Philosophy
content:
## Professional Philosophy

I believe therapy works best when it's collaborative, grounded in evidence, and tailored to who you are. My role isn't to hand you answers — it's to walk alongside you as you find your own.

## Personal Philosophy

Outside of the therapy room, I try to live by the same values I bring into it: curiosity, compassion, and the belief that growth is possible at any stage of life.
